'''Argaian hemiolias''' were a model of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] named for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argai]] dating to before the rise of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Hemiolias were one of many models of warship used by the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] despot [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], mixed into squadrons also including [[Livien cutter]]s, [[Thanium star-glaive]]s and [[Cronian battlebird/Legends|Cronian battlebirds]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''7</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Argaian hemiolia were first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a reference book released in [[2012]] and written by [[Jason Fry]].
